from pathlib import Path
cases = {
"ref_blank_eof":"[x]: y\n",
"ref_blank2":"[x]: y\n\n",
"ref_space_blank":"[x]: y \n",
"ref_space_blank2":"[x]: y \n\n",
"inline_break_blank":"[a](b\n\n",
"inline_space_blank":"[a](b \n\n",
"inline_title_blank":"[a](b \n",
"inline_title_blank2":"[a](b \n\n",
"inline_title_blank3":"[a](b\n \n",
"ref_title_multinoend":"[x]: y \"abc\n",
"ref_title_escape_eof":"[x]: y \"abc\\",
"inline_title_escape_eof":"[a](b \"abc\\",
}
for name,s in cases.items():
    Path(f"/tmp/{name}.md").write_bytes(s.encode())
PY
for f in /tmp/*.md; do echo ===$f===; ASAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:detect_leaks=0 /tmp/md2html_asan --replay-fuzz <(python3 -c "import sys,struct; sys.stdout.buffer.write(struct.pack(\"II\",0,0)+open(\"$f\",\"rb\").read())") >/tmp/out 2>/tmp/err || { cat /tmp/err; break; }; done'` executed with exit code 0.
